close_reason: Removed 'when the URI is known' hedge; doc now says 'Always use this instead'
description: unknown_capability_with_detail's doc comment says 'Use this in preference to unknown_capability() when the URI is known', hedging with a condition. But the deprecated note on unknown_capability() now says 'always use unknown_capability_with_detail'. A future contributor reading the _with_detail doc may infer there are legitimate cases to call the bare unknown_capability(). The hedge should be removed from _with_detail's doc to match the 'always' policy — scenario: contributor sees hedge, concludes unknown_capability() is acceptable when URI is unavailable, adds a call site, triggering a deprecation suppression pattern. Maintenance consequence: repeated incorrect usage and PRs that have to be corrected.
title: unknown_capability_with_detail doc still says 'when URI is known' — contradicts 'always use' deprecation
